# Product Requirements Document (PRD): AI-Powered Music Generation Platform

## 1. Overview
### 1.1 Product Name
MelodyForge AI

### 1.2 Product Description
A cloud-based platform that uses AI to generate royalty-free original music tracks based on user-defined parameters (genre, mood, tempo, duration). Supports commercial use with customizable outputs.

### 1.3 Target Users
- Content creators (YouTubers, podcasters)
- Game developers
- Advertising agencies
- Independent musicians
- Film/TV producers

## 2. Objectives
1. Reduce music licensing costs for creators
2. Democratize access to custom music
3. Provide 10x faster music creation vs traditional methods
4. Maintain human-quality musical output

## 3. Features & Requirements

### 3.1 Core Functionality
| Feature | Description | Priority |
|---------|------------|----------|
| AI Music Generation | Generate 30s-5min tracks using GANs/Transformers | P0 |
| Style Parameters | 50+ genre presets, mood sliders (aggressive/calm) | P0 |
| Customization | Adjust tempo (40-200BPM), key, instrumentation | P1 |
| Stem Export | Separate tracks for vocals/bass/drums/etc. | P2 |

### 3.2 User Experience
| Feature | Description | Priority |
|---------|------------|----------|
| Web DAW | Browser-based digital audio workstation | P1 |
| Mobile App | iOS/Android for on-the-go creation | P2 |
| Project Templates | "YouTube intro", "Podcast theme" etc. | P1 |

### 3.3 Business Model
| Component | Specification |
|-----------|--------------|
| Pricing | Freemium: $0/5 tracks monthly, $20/unlimited |
| Licensing | All outputs royalty-free with commercial rights |
| API Access | $0.10/request for developers (1000 req min) |

## 4. Technical Specifications

### 4.1 AI Architecture
- **Model**: Variational Autoencoder + Transformer hybrid
- **Training Data**: 500k licensed tracks across genres
- **Output Quality**: 44.1kHz/16bit WAV (CD quality)
- **Generation Time**: <30 seconds for 3min track

### 4.2 Infrastructure
- AWS EC2 p3.2xlarge instances for GPU acceleration
- Cloudflare CDN for global low-latency delivery
- MongoDB Atlas for user project storage

## 5. Success Metrics
1. **Adoption**: 10,000 MAU within 6 months
2. **Quality**: 85% user satisfaction (post-gen survey)
3. **Revenue**: $50k MRR by Year 1
4. **Performance**: <2s UI response time

## 6. Roadmap
| Quarter | Milestones |
|---------|------------|
| Q1 2024 | Core web platform launch |
| Q2 2024 | Mobile apps release |
| Q3 2024 | Collaboration features |
| Q4 2024 | Lyrics generation add-on |

## 7. Risks & Mitigation
1. **Copyright Risks**: Implement audio fingerprinting to ensure originality
2. **Quality Issues**: Human-in-the-loop quality control system
3. **Market Fit**: Start with creator-focused MVP before expanding

## 8. Open Questions
1. Optimal pricing tier structure?
2. Should we offer human mastering as upsell?
3. Partnership strategy with stock music platforms?
